issues.detail: The instructions do not cover error scenarios or edge cases.
The skill contains verbose explanatory sections that could be trimmed.

scenarios.name: create-flutter-project-with-dependencies
scenarios.rationale: Both miss the exact org flag, but B lists each dependency command separately, whereas A combines them into one command.

scenarios.name: add-auth-notifier-with-dio
scenarios.rationale: Response B meets most rubric items (Notifier, build, login, storage, provider) but misses the explicit ref.read(apiClientProvider) call; Response A uses StateNotifier and a different API call, missing several rubric requirements.

scenarios.name: setup-go-router-auth-guard
scenarios.rationale: Response B meets almost all rubric requirements except the missing '/project/:id' route, while Response A fails to use a Provider<GoRouter>, ValueNotifier, or the specified redirect logic.
